caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall-mounted shelving unit consisting of three primary sections. The upper part features a rectangular shelf with three equally sized drawers aligned horizontally, each drawer equipped with a small, round knob in the center. The wood grain is visible throughout the object, rendered in shades of brown. The sides of the shelving unit are formed by two vertical wooden panels with a curved cut-out design along their inner edges. Below the drawer section, there is a single, flat shelf spanning the width between the side panels. The background is an unembellished off-white or light beige color, and there are no additional objects or details present apart from the shelving unit itself.
title: Sideboard
